foreign_waiver.results.title: KBO foreign reserve-rights list closes
foreign_waiver.results.title.v2: KBO clubs finish foreign-player rights calls
foreign_waiver.results.body_with_breakdo:
The KBO foreign-player reserve-rights window has closed. Clubs have sorted the players they still want tied to a future return from the names they are ready to release into the market.

This year's closeout left {retained} players retained and {skipped} released. A retained player is not necessarily staying on the roster, but any KBO return begins with his original club's negotiating rights.

The league table now shows {active_rights} active foreign reserve-right records, a small piece of offseason paperwork that can still shape the next import market.

After the deadline, {active_rights} active foreign reserve-right records remain on file.
